blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A motorcycle rider caught spitting at a public bus driver during a road altercation in Talisay City faces possible administrative sanctions. This comes after the Land Transportation Office in Central Visayas (LTO-7) ordered both drivers to surrender their licenses pending an investigation.
